name: plaid-pfc
description: Plaid's Personal Finance Category (PFC) taxonomy, pinned and strictly enforced: the 127 v2 detailed names with Plaid's descriptions, a v1-to-v2 crosswalk (renames and splits), validation that refuses any invented name, standard I/O records with JSON Schema for enum-bound LLM output, and a refresh that diffs Plaid's published CSV. Stdlib Python only; holds no data.
